test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

He is bent __to harm__ me as much as he can.
solution:
The correct answer is** "upon harming"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Bent upon/on" means "to be very determined to do something"
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He was bent upon quitting his job even though he was making a lot of money.
 
 
 
• So the correct sentence is- *He is** bent upon harming** me as much as he can.*
